newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices continue to slide.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices continue to slide.

text.p: Millfeed prices were mostly lower again Tuesday, pressured by feed mixers using other feed ingredients in rations and by an overall slowdown in feed demand, dealers said.
"It's going down and there is nothing they can do about it," said a Carolina dealer. He said corn is replacing millfeeds there because it is priced competively.
The sharp drop in CBOT corn futures Monday prompted swift price-cutting in millfeed markets, dealers said.
Prices were lower in Southern California as well, where dealers said barley, corn and wheat were displacing millfeeds in dairy rations.
